description: Hoist the colors! Generate swashbuckling pirate names with epithets, or legendary ship names like “The Salty Serpent”.

faqs.a: Pirate mode builds first names plus epithets (like Jack “Deadeye”); ship mode builds “The” + adjective + noun ship names.
Yes — epithets range from “One-Eye” to “the Terrible”, giving every pirate a story.
Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy a name?

howto: Choose pirate names or ship names.
Press Generate, then click any result to copy it.
title: Pirate Name Generator
